task.title: P6-112: Reject to_collection_id == collection_id in teardown
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-112. Size: S. Specs: specs/collection-api.md.

**`teardown` does not reject `to_collection_id == collection_id`** (was `P6-055f`). `hosted.rs:1193-1200` checks ownership of both ids but never compares them; the loop at `:1226-1253` then writes ledger rows with `from == to` — which `apply_move` forbids elsewhere — and collapses every board onto `main`. The UI excludes the self-destination (`collection.rs:559`) but the endpoint accepts it, so any API caller reaches it. Highest-value fix in the old `P6-055` bundle.
